<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 183.045 (assumed [M+H]⁺). Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈182.038 Da. The formula that best matches this mass and shows an appropriate ^13C isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity) is C₉H₁₀O₄. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C9H10O4.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H10O4</final_answer>
